site.name: Stocka
site.description: A clear inventory for your items: what they are, where they are and who owns them. No spreadsheets, no chaos.

hero.sub: Stocka is a clear inventory for your items: what they are, where they're located, who really owns them and all their information. No spreadsheets, no chaos.

features.title: Everything you need to take control of your inventory.
features.sub: Built for teams that need to know what they have and where, without setting up an entire ERP.

item.title: Complete record per item
item.body: Name, description, serial number, photos and documents. All the information in one place.

location.title: Physical location
location.body: Room, shelf, drawer… Define the hierarchy that fits best and find any item instantly.

owner.title: Real owner
owner.body: Track who actually owns each item, not just who keeps it. Ideal for shared assets.

category.title: Types and categories
category.body: Group by item type and add custom fields to match each kind. No rigid forms.

label.title: Codes and labels
label.body: Generate and print labels with QR or barcode. Scan with your phone to view the record instantly.

history.title: History and audit
history.body: Every move, transfer or change of owner is recorded with date and responsible party.

how.title: Start tracking your inventory in 10 minutes.
how.sub: Import your list, invite your team and start logging items. Just like that.

create.title: Create your items
create.body: Upload a CSV or add them by hand. Define the types, locations and owners that match your case.

invite.title: Invite your team
invite.body: Add your teammates with roles and permissions. Each person sees and edits what is theirs.

maintain.title: Keep the record alive
maintain.body: Transfers, owner changes and updates from mobile or desktop. Everything is audited.

testimonial.label: Testimonial
testimonial.quote: “We had assets scattered across offices and nobody knew whose was whose. With Stocka we find any item in seconds and we always know who it belongs to.”
testimonial.author: Laura Méndez

cta.label: Call to action
cta.title: Bring order to your inventory today.
cta.sub: Start free, no card needed. Create your first item in a couple of minutes and see if it fits.

footer.tagline: Simple, honest inventory for teams who want to know what they have, where it is and whose it is.
